Add a question, choose Matrix, list the rows, and pick the scale every row is rated on.

![The grid of rating questions question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/grid-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/grid-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Rows.** The things rated. Each row becomes its own column, named after it.
- **Answer set.** The scale every row shares.

## Best practices for research

Keep a grid short: long grids invite the same answer down every row, which the quality checks flag as straight-lining.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
